info.background_text:
Problem solver of the Azure Merchant Guild.
Runs Hugo's Solutions aboard the Caravan Ark, handling everything from troublesome monsters and collecting debts to finding people. He takes on both trivial and dangerous tasks. When not working, he often appears lethargic and lazy.
